segments.t: 周六正午十二点整的钟声在菩提树庭院客栈敲响。汉娜接起前台响个不停的黑电话，一旁的亚瑟正整理着西装翻领，格雷厄姆则在核对客房登记簿。先完整听一遍对话。
Good afternoon, Linden Courtyard in Portland, Hannah speaking — how may I help you today?
Who is calling at noon, Hannah? Is another neighbor asking for a courtyard seat?
Yes, operator, read the station telegram slowly... arriving on the early express at THREE?!
Three in the afternoon?! Wait — the anniversary tea is scheduled for six this evening!
Thank you very much for calling ahead — goodbye! Gentlemen, put down your teacups!
Did you just say our guest of honor arrives three full hours early?!
Track repair moved his evening connection onto the fast afternoon express into Portland!
Three hours left! The cakes are still batter, and the duet is half rehearsed!
Take one deep breath, boss, before you lose the glasses sitting on your nose.
First job: I sprint to the kitchen so Tessa heats both ovens right now!
Second job: Arthur, send quick word down Linden Street inviting neighbors for half past three.
Wait — right after I checked in Rooms Two and Six, where did their keys go?!
第五集一开场，电话铃声就把原本悠闲的午间茶歇瞬间变成了和时间赛跑。这一段全是打电话用语、交通调度和紧急分派任务，我们逐句精学。
Good afternoon, Linden Courtyard in Portland, Hannah speaking — how may I help you today?
'下午好，这里是波特兰的菩提树庭院客栈，我是汉娜——请问今天有什么可以帮您？' 汉娜飞快拿起听筒接起电话。英语接电话自报家门时，常用“名字 + speaking”，意思就是“我是某某、某某在接听”，请听：
Hannah speaking
紧接着她礼貌地询问对方有什么需求，用上了很得体的服务业常用情态动词 may：
how may I help you today
Who is calling at noon, Hannah? Is another neighbor asking for a courtyard seat?
'大中午的是谁打来的呀，汉娜？又是有邻居来问庭院里还有没有位子吗？' 在旁边的亚瑟小声发问，想知道是谁在这个点来电。问电话那头是谁时，英语习惯用现在进行时：
Who is calling at noon
接着他顺口猜测是不是又有邻居要添座，注意 another 表示“另一个”，直接接单数名词 neighbor，中间不加冠词：
another neighbor
Yes, operator, read the station telegram slowly... arriving on the early express at THREE?!
'对，接线员，麻烦把车站电报念慢一点……改乘早班快车三点就到？！' 电话那头传来车站接线员的消息，汉娜赶紧让对方慢一点念出电报内容。副词 slowly“慢慢地”修饰动词 read：
read the station telegram slowly
紧接着就听到了最令人震惊的部分，说明搭乘某趟快车时要用介词 on：
arriving on the early express
Three in the afternoon?! Wait — the anniversary tea is scheduled for six this evening!
'下午三点？！等等——周年茶会不是定在今晚六点吗！' 汉娜简直不敢相信自己的耳朵，连忙核对原本的时间。表达某事被正式安排在几点，最地道的结构是 be scheduled for：
the anniversary tea is scheduled for six
这里的 this evening 指的就是“今天傍晚”：
this evening
Thank you very much for calling ahead — goodbye! Gentlemen, put down your teacups!
'非常感谢您提前来电告知——再见！各位先生，快把茶杯放下吧！' 挂断前汉娜还是不忘保持专业礼貌，thank... for calling ahead 表示“感谢提前来电告知”：
Thank you very much for calling ahead
放下听筒的一刹那，她的语气瞬间切回实战模式，短语动词 put down 指“把手里的东西放下”：
put down your teacups
Did you just say our guest of honor arrives three full hours early?!
'你刚才是不是说，我们的贵宾要足足提前三个小时到达？！' 亚瑟一听脸色都变了，用“Did you just say...?”确认自己没听错，just 搭配过去时表示刚刚说出口的话：
Did you just say
后面的 full 用来加重数量的分量，three full hours early 就是“整整早了三个小时”：
three full hours early
Track repair moved his evening connection onto the fast afternoon express into Portland!
'轨道维修把他原本晚上的换乘车次改到了开往波特兰的下午特快列车上！' 汉娜简短解释了铁路改点的原因：track repair 是“轨道维修”，connection 在交通出行里指“换乘、接驳班次”：
Track repair moved his evening connection
表示把行程改签或转接到另一趟车上时，用介词 onto 引出改乘的车次：
onto the fast afternoon express
Three hours left! The cakes are still batter, and the duet is half rehearsed!
'只剩三个小时了！蛋糕现在还只是面糊，四手联弹也才排练了一半！' 亚瑟扳着指头一算，瞬间炸了毛。放在时间数量后面的 left 表示“剩余的、剩下的”：
Three hours left
而在过去分词 rehearsed 前面加上 half，就能简洁表达“只排练了一半”：
the duet is half rehearsed
Take one deep breath, boss, before you lose the glasses sitting on your nose.
'先深吸一口气吧，老板，免得把架在鼻梁上的眼镜又给弄丢了。' 一直稳坐钓鱼台的格雷厄姆赶紧叫老板定定神。英语说“深呼吸”必须搭配动词 take，说成 take a deep breath：
Take one deep breath, boss
在连词 before 引导的时间从句里要用一般现在时，提醒老板趁眼镜还没滑丢赶紧深呼吸：
before you lose the glasses
First job: I sprint to the kitchen so Tessa heats both ovens right now!
'第一件事：我百米冲刺去厨房，让泰莎立刻把两台烤箱都预热起来！' 格雷厄姆立刻拿出救火队长般的效率安排第一步。动词 sprint 指“全速冲刺”：
I sprint to the kitchen
副词短语 right now 再次拉满紧迫感，催着厨房马上升温：
heats both ovens right now
Second job: Arthur, send quick word down Linden Street inviting neighbors for half past three.
'第二件事：亚瑟，赶紧沿菩提树街传个信儿，请邻居们三点半过来。' 第二步立刻派给了亚瑟，send word 意思是“捎口信、传话通知”：
send quick word down Linden Street
英语报半点时间常用 half past 加上整点数，half past three 就是“三点半”：
for half past three
Wait — right after I checked in Rooms Two and Six, where did their keys go?!
'等等——我刚给二号房和六号房办完入住，它们的钥匙去哪儿了？！' 就在大家风风火火往外冲时，亚瑟突然低头盯住柜台愣住了。check in 在酒店场景里表示“为客人办理入住登记”：
right after I checked in Rooms Two and Six
他疑惑刚才明明摆在这里的钥匙怎么不见了。询问某件东西下落不明时，口语最常说 where did... go：
where did their keys go
注意最后这句问句里借用了助动词 did，所以后面的 go 保持原形，意思是“钥匙到哪儿去了”。现在，让我们把这一段紧凑的对话完整再听一遍。
Good afternoon, Linden Courtyard in Portland, Hannah speaking — how may I help you today?
Who is calling at noon, Hannah? Is another neighbor asking for a courtyard seat?
Yes, operator, read the station telegram slowly... arriving on the early express at THREE?!
Three in the afternoon?! Wait — the anniversary tea is scheduled for six this evening!
Thank you very much for calling ahead — goodbye! Gentlemen, put down your teacups!
Did you just say our guest of honor arrives three full hours early?!
Track repair moved his evening connection onto the fast afternoon express into Portland!
Three hours left! The cakes are still batter, and the duet is half rehearsed!
Take one deep breath, boss, before you lose the glasses sitting on your nose.
First job: I sprint to the kitchen so Tessa heats both ovens right now!
Second job: Arthur, send quick word down Linden Street inviting neighbors for half past three.
Wait — right after I checked in Rooms Two and Six, where did their keys go?!
一通电话让三个小时瞬间蒸发——而且亚瑟刚刚在木制钥匙挂板上发现了奇怪的事情！我们下次见。
See you next time!
